facts.value: There are two student fee classifications - EU and Non-EU
EU fee status applies to Domestic or EU students, or students who have been resident as a taxpayer in EU/EEA/Swiss State for 3 out of the last 5 years.
Non-EU fee status applies to all other students.
Courses costing upwards of €5,000 a year.
Tax relief is available on postgraduate tuition fees, up to €7,000 per person per course.
Tax relief is available for tuition fees paid for approved postgraduate courses in private and publicly funded colleges in the State.
Tax relief is available for postgraduate courses in a university or publicly funded college in another EU member state or the UK, including such colleges that provide distance education in the State.
Tax relief is available for postgraduate courses in a university or publicly funded third-level college in non-EU countries.
